# Commands

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from src/cli/registry.mjs and each command module. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every command prints text, or one JSON object with `--json`. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 a check failed, 2 the command could not run. Commands that change something take `--dry-run`.

## Global options

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object on stdout instead of text |
| `--dry-run` | Show what would change without changing anything |
| `--cwd <value>` | Run as if started in this directory |
| `--verbose` | Print diagnostic detail on stderr |
| `--help` (`-h`) | Show help |
| `--version` (`-v`) | Print the version |

## help

Show help for agent-os or for one command. Status: new (#3).

```
agent-os help [command]
```

## version

Print the agent-os version. Status: new (#3).

```
agent-os version [--check] [--json]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--check` | Compare with the project's pinned version |

## init

Set up agent-os; --me sets only your personal settings (full init: #49). Status: new (#99).

```
agent-os init [--profile <p>] [--platform github|gitlab --project <owner/name> [--host <url>]] [--integration <b>] [--production <b>] [--lang en|ro] [--area-lang <area>=<en|ro>…] [--solo|--team] [--chat en|ro] [--setup] [--yes] [--dry-run]
       agent-os init --detect [--json]
       agent-os init --me [--chat en|ro] [--sessions <n>] [--orchestrator] [--dev-port <port>] [--min-free-mb <mb>] [--yes]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--me` | Only your personal settings (chat language, sessions, machine limits) |
| `--profile <value>` | greenfield, spec-first, active or maintenance (default: the detected one) |
| `--platform <value>` | github or gitlab (default: from the origin remote) |
| `--project <value>` | owner/name or group/name (default: from the origin remote) |
| `--host <value>` | Self-managed host, https://… |
| `--integration <value>` | The integration branch, made the default branch (default development) |
| `--production <value>` | The production branch (default main) |
| `--lang <value>` | Language of every team area: en or ro (Romanian without diacritics) |
| `--area-lang <value>`, repeatable | One area in another language, e.g. --area-lang issues=ro (repeat) |
| `--solo` | One person: no required approvals |
| `--team` | A team: one approval required on change requests |
| `--methodology <value>` | For an existing repository: forward-only (conventions from today on) or retrofit (#50) |
| `--author <value>` | The login for the baseline journal entry (default: your platform login) |
| `--setup` | Also apply the platform setup (branches, protection, labels, milestone); asks first unless --yes |
| `--detect` | Only read the repository and suggest a profile (greenfield, spec-first, active, maintenance); writes nothing |
| `--chat <value>` | Language the agent talks to you in: en or ro |
| `--sessions <value>` | Most agent sessions you run in parallel on this laptop (1 = one at a time) |
| `--orchestrator` | One of your sessions coordinates the others |
| `--dev-port <value>` | First dev-server port for parallel worktrees |
| `--min-free-mb <value>` | Refuse heavy commands below this much free memory |
| `--yes` (`-y`) | Do not ask; use flags and defaults |

## config

Read, change or validate agent-os.json and your personal settings. Status: new (#4).

```
agent-os config [get [key] | set <key> <value> | unset <key> | validate | path]
```

## doctor

Check the agent system, the repository and platform hygiene; readiness score; --fix. Status: new (#27).

```
agent-os doctor [--offline | --ci] [--fix] [--check <id>…]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--offline` | Local checks only: no platform calls |
| `--ci` | What the CI loop check runs: local, deterministic checks |
| `--fix` | Apply the mechanical fixes, then check again |
| `--check <value>`, repeatable | Run only this check (repeat): skills, slots, commands, hooks, links, area-map, stack, system, headers, standards, budgets, language, journal, lessons, decisions, artifacts, conflicts, version, lifecycle, gitignore, personal, issues, labels, titles |

## env

Check MCP servers, CLIs, token scopes and variables, on this laptop and in the repo. Status: new (#9).

```
agent-os env [--fast | --ci]   ·   env propose [--accept <id>… | --accept-all] [--dry-run]   (requirements the stack suggests)
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--fast` | Only the checks that need no commands (under a second): repo side and variables |
| `--ci` | Only the repository side, for CI (the laptop is not the runner) |
| `--accept <value>`, repeatable | propose: add this proposal (mcp:<name> or cli:<name>) to agent-os.json |
| `--accept-all` | propose: add every proposal |

## update

Plan and run an upgrade of agent-os, on its own branch, as a change request. Status: new (#68).

```
agent-os update [--plan] [--channel latest|next] [--no-pr] [--dry-run]
       agent-os update --relock | --migrate [--dry-run]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--plan` | Show what the update changes, grouped, without changing anything |
| `--channel <value>` | latest (default) or next: try a pre-release without changing the pinned version |
| `--no-pr` | Do the update on its branch but do not push or open the change request |
| `--relock` | Rebuild .agent-os/lock.json from .agent-os/base/ |
| `--migrate` | Run the migrations from the pinned version to the running one |

## eject

Stop managing a file, block or hooks entry; the content stays as it is. Status: new (#6).

```
agent-os eject <path | path#block-id | path#hooks>
```

## hook

Run the Claude Code hook handlers for an event (called from .claude/settings.json). Status: new (#8).

```
agent-os hook <SessionStart|PreToolUse|PostToolUse|Stop>   (reads the event JSON on stdin)
       agent-os hook --print-settings
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--print-settings` | Print the hooks block for .claude/settings.json |

## platform

Show the code platform and its login, or detect it from the git remote (GitHub, GitLab). Status: new (#90).

```
agent-os platform [show | detect [--remote <url>] [--write] [--yes] | probe [--refresh] | switch --to github|gitlab --project <owner/name> [--host <url>] [--map <importer-map.json>] --plan]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--remote <value>` | Detect from this URL instead of the "origin" remote |
| `--write` | Save the detected platform to agent-os.json (asks first) |
| `--yes` (`-y`) | Do not ask before writing |
| `--refresh` | probe: ask the platform again instead of using the cached map |
| `--to <value>` | switch: the platform to move to (github or gitlab) |
| `--project <value>` | switch: the project on the new platform (owner/name or group/name) |
| `--host <value>` | switch: a self-managed host on the new platform, https://… |
| `--map <value>` | switch: the importer's map of old to new references, JSON {"#12": "#7", "#40": "!3"} |
| `--plan` | switch: show and save the plan; nothing in the repository changes |

## lang

Show or set the language of each area (renaming labels and milestones), check ro text, print the language rule. Status: new (#7).

```
agent-os lang [show | set <area> <en|ro> [--dry-run] | check <file...> [--area <area>] [--text <text>] | rule]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--area <value>` | Only check when this area is set to ro |
| `--text <value>` | Check this text instead of files |

## issue

Create, relate, assign, branch and place issues on the board; read progress. Status: new (#12).

```
agent-os issue new --title "<Area>: <problem>" --body-file <f> --label <type> --label <priority> --label <area> --milestone <m> [--assignee <u>…] [--parent <n>] [--blocked-by <n>…] [--blocks <n>…] [--extend <n> | --force-new]
       agent-os issue similar "<title>"   ·   comment <n> --body-file <f>
       agent-os issue get|children|blockers <n>
       agent-os issue create --title <t> [--body-file <f>] [--label <l>…] [--milestone <m>] [--assignee <u>…] [--parent <n>] [--blocked-by <n>…] [--status <s>]
       agent-os issue update <n> [--title <t>] [--body-file <f>] [--state open|closed] [--milestone <m>] [--label <l>…] [--remove-label <l>…]
       agent-os issue relate <child> --parent <n>   ·   block <n> --blocked-by <m>…   ·   assign <n> <login>…
       agent-os issue branch <n> --name <branch> [--base <branch>]   ·   status <n> <value> [--field <name>]   ·   progress [--milestone <m>]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--title <value>` | Issue title |
| `--body-file <value>` | Read the issue body from this file |
| `--label <value>`, repeatable | A label (repeat for several) |
| `--remove-label <value>`, repeatable | A label to remove (repeat for several) |
| `--milestone <value>` | Milestone title |
| `--assignee <value>`, repeatable | An assignee login (repeat for several) |
| `--parent <value>` | Parent issue number (sub-issue relationship) |
| `--blocked-by <value>`, repeatable | An issue number that blocks this one (repeat for several) |
| `--status <value>` | Board status to set (Todo, In Progress, Done, …) |
| `--state <value>` | open or closed |
| `--name <value>` | Branch name |
| `--base <value>` | Base branch |
| `--field <value>` | Board field to set (default Status) |
| `--blocks <value>`, repeatable | new: an issue number this one blocks (repeat for several) |
| `--extend <value>` | new: add this as a comment on an existing issue instead of creating one |
| `--force-new` | new: create it even when similar issues exist |

## manifest

Build and check the lifecycle manifest; list deprecated items this project still uses. Status: new (#66).

```
agent-os manifest [build [--out <file>] | check [--previous <file>] | usage]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--out <value>` | build: where to write (default manifest.json in the package) |

## start

Claim an issue: assign, branch from the right base, link, In Progress, check out. Status: new (#14).

```
agent-os start <issue> [--hotfix] [--worktree] [--force] [--dry-run]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--hotfix` | Branch from the production branch (urgent fix for production) |
| `--worktree` | Check the branch out in its own worktree (.claude/worktrees/…), for parallel sessions |
| `--force` | Start even though someone else is assigned (after they agreed) |

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--limit <value>` | How many recommendations (default 3) |

Keep the optional planning board in step with the issues (GitHub Projects). Status: new (#20).

```

```

|---|---|

| `--title <value>` | create: the board title |

## handoff

Status comments on the issues you hold and a handoff journal entry. Status: new (#36).

```
agent-os handoff [--next <issue>="<what comes next>"…] [--summary "<text>"] [--dry-run]
```

## thread

Read the conversation on an issue or change request: decisions, language, participants. Status: new (#34).

```
agent-os thread <#N | !N> [--json]   (!N or --change-request: a change request)
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--change-request` | N is a change request (on GitLab, where issues and merge requests are numbered apart) |

## overlap

List open changes that touch the same files as yours. Status: new (#33).

```
agent-os overlap [--path <p>…] [--base <branch>] [--offline]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--path <value>`, repeatable | Check these paths instead of the branch changes (a folder ends with /) |
| `--base <value>` | Compare against origin/<base> (default: branches.integration) |
| `--offline` | Pushed branches only; no platform calls |

## test

Plan scenarios into issues, write results into change requests, run suites, find test gaps. Status: new (#44).

```
agent-os test plan <issue> [--write] [--dry-run] | pr [<n>] [--dry-run] | local [--all] [--suite <name>…] | gaps
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--write` | plan: add the proposed scenarios to the issue |
| `--all` | local: every suite |
| `--suite <value>`, repeatable | local: only this suite (repeat) |

## gate

Run the checks the current diff needs. Status: new (#43).

```
agent-os gate [--base <branch>] [--all] [--suite <name>…] [--from-ci] [--dry-run]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--base <value>` | Compare against origin/<base> (default: branches.integration) |
| `--all` | Run every suite, whatever changed |
| `--suite <value>`, repeatable | Run only this suite (repeat for several) |
| `--from-ci` | In CI: the base from the change request event; a push runs every suite; results go to the job summary |

## ci

Review CI workflows against best practice (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI); the /ci checklist. Status: new (#45).

```
agent-os ci review [<file>…] [--strict] [--json]   ·   checklist
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--strict` | review: warnings fail too |

## pr

Open the change request when it is ready; its checks and review threads. Status: new (#15).

```
agent-os pr preflight --title "<title>" --body-file <file>
       agent-os pr create --title "<title>" --body-file <file> [--draft] [--dry-run]
       agent-os pr status [<n>] [--watch]
       agent-os pr threads [<n>] [--all]
       agent-os pr reply <thread-id> --body-file <file> [--pr <n>] [--resolve] [--dry-run]   (in the comment's language; @mentions only for participants)
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--title <value>` | preflight/create: the title |
| `--body-file <value>` | The body (create, preflight) or the reply (reply) |
| `--base <value>` | The target branch (default: branches.integration) |
| `--draft` | create: open it as a draft |
| `--watch` | status: wait until no check is pending (at most 30 minutes) |
| `--all` | threads: include resolved threads |
| `--resolve` | reply: resolve the thread after replying |
| `--pr <value>` | reply: the change request the thread is on (default: the one for this branch) |

## ship

Merge a green, reviewed change request; close or comment on its issues; clean up the branch. Status: new (#16).

```
agent-os ship [<n>] [--no-notify] [--keep-branch] [--dry-run]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--no-notify` | Do not comment to the author when the change request is behind or conflicting |
| `--keep-branch` | Do not delete the branch and its worktree after merging |

## release

Plan, open and finish a release (merge commit, tag, notes, milestone roll, sync back); release notes. Status: new (#17).

```
agent-os release plan --version <x.y.z> [--hotfix]
       agent-os release open --version <x.y.z> [--dry-run]
       agent-os release finish --version <x.y.z> [--hotfix] [--accept <risk id>…] [--dry-run]
       agent-os release notes --from <tag or commit> [--to <ref>] --version <x.y.z> [--changelog] [--dry-run]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--from <value>` | notes: the previous release (tag or commit) |
| `--to <value>` | notes: the end of the range (default HEAD) |
| `--version <value>` | notes: the version being released |
| `--changelog` | notes: also add the entry to changelog.yaml (read by update --plan) |
| `--hotfix` | plan/finish: release what is on the production branch (a hotfix), then sync it back |
| `--accept <value>`, repeatable | finish: accept a risk the plan found (destructive:<file>, env:<NAME>, or a kind) |

## standards

Record a choice between solutions the way the standards ask. Status: new (#102).

```
agent-os standards choice --title "<the question>" --option "<id>: <one line>" --option "<id>: <one line>" --pick <id> --why "<one sentence>" [--criterion <name>="<note>"…] [--record <slug>]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--title <value>` | choice: the question being decided |
| `--option <value>`, repeatable | choice: "<id>: <one line>" (two or three) |
| `--pick <value>` | choice: the id of the chosen candidate |
| `--why <value>` | choice: the reason, in one sentence |
| `--criterion <value>`, repeatable | choice: <criterion>=<note> (correctness, simplicity, fit, performance, testability, cost of change) |
| `--record <value>` | choice: also write a decision record with this slug (for choices that are hard to reverse) |

## check

Check a pull or merge request title against its description, or a commit message. Status: new (#19).

```
agent-os check title "<title>" [--body-file <file> | --pr <n>]
       agent-os check commit [--message-file <file> | --ref <rev>]
       agent-os check loop (--body-file <file> [--base <branch>] [--author <login>] | --from-ci)
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--body-file <value>` | title: the description to match the issue suffix against |
| `--pr <value>` | title: read the title and description of this pull or merge request |
| `--message-file <value>` | commit: the message to check |
| `--ref <value>` | commit: check this commit (default HEAD) |
| `--base <value>` | loop: the target branch (default: branches.integration) |
| `--author <value>` | loop: the author login (dependency bots are exempt) |
| `--from-ci` | loop: read the description, author and target branch from the CI event (GitHub Actions or GitLab CI) |

## map

Render a map of one area of the code, on demand. Status: new (#26).

```
agent-os map [path] [--budget <tokens>]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--budget <value>` | Most tokens to use (about 4 characters each; default 1500) |

## journal

Add to or read the project journal. Status: new (#22).

```
agent-os journal [list [filters] | show <id> | add --type <t> --title <text> --area <a>… [--ref <#N>…] [--body-file <f>] [--thread <#N|!N>…] | check]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--type <value>` | Entry type: decision, lesson, incident, release, handoff, note (add; a filter for list) |
| `--title <value>` | add: the entry title |
| `--body <value>` | add: the body text |
| `--body-file <value>` | add: read the body from a file |
| `--area <value>`, repeatable | An area (repeat for several; list: filter by one) |
| `--ref <value>`, repeatable | A reference: #N, !N, &N or a decision id (repeat; list: filter by one) |
| `--author <value>` | add: the author login (default: your platform login); list: filter |
| `--at <value>` | add: the time of the entry (ISO 8601, default now) |
| `--since <value>` | list: from this date or time |
| `--until <value>` | list: up to this date or time |
| `--thread <value>`, repeatable | add: quote the decisions made in the comments of this issue (#N) or change request (!N), verbatim |

## lessons

Capture, recall, search and triage lessons learned. Status: new (#24).

```
agent-os lessons add "<the lesson in one sentence, why, an example>" --area <a>… [--path <glob>…] [--keyword <w>…] --source "<where>"
       agent-os lessons recall [--issue <n> | --path <p>… | --changed] [--area <a>…] [--limit 3]
       agent-os lessons search <words>
       agent-os lessons review | accept <id> [--as <slug>] | promote <id> --to "<rule>" | retire <id> --reason "<why>"
       agent-os lessons check
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--area <value>`, repeatable | An area (repeat) |
| `--path <value>`, repeatable | add: a glob the lesson applies to; recall: a path being worked on (repeat) |
| `--keyword <value>`, repeatable | add: a keyword that recalls it (repeat) |
| `--source <value>` | add: where it came from (issue, PR, review comment, incident) |
| `--confidence <value>` | add: low, likely, medium, high (default medium) |
| `--body-file <value>` | add: read the lesson text from a file |
| `--author <value>` | add: the author login (default: your platform login) |
| `--issue <value>` | recall: what applies to this issue (its areas, the paths and words it mentions) |
| `--changed` | recall: what applies to the files changed on this branch |
| `--limit <value>` | recall: at most this many cards (default 3) |
| `--as <value>` | accept: the slug of the active card |
| `--to <value>` | promote: the rule or file the lesson became |
| `--reason <value>` | retire: why it no longer needs recalling |
| `--all` | search: include retired cards |

## retro

Triage the lessons inbox and repeated review findings; keep the Retro issue up to date. Status: new (#29).

```
agent-os retro plan [--recent <n>] [--offline] | apply [--accept <id>…] [--promote <id>=<rule>…] [--reject <id>=<reason>…] | issue [--dry-run]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--recent <value>` | plan: look for repeated review findings in the last n merged change requests (default 10) |
| `--offline` | plan: the inbox only, no review findings |
| `--accept <value>`, repeatable | apply: keep this lesson as an active card |
| `--promote <value>`, repeatable | apply: <id>=<rule file: section> it became |
| `--reject <value>`, repeatable | apply: <id>=<reason> |

## decision

Create, list and check decision records with date-based ids. Status: new (#23).

```
agent-os decision new <slug> --title "<the decision>" [--supersedes <id>] [--accepted] [--dry-run] | list | check
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--title <value>` | new: the decision in a few words |
| `--supersedes <value>` | new: the record this one replaces (its status is pointed here) |
| `--accepted` | new: start as accepted instead of proposed |

## chronicle

One timeline from the platform and the journal, rendered into the cache. Status: new (#25).

```
agent-os chronicle --since <YYYY-MM-DD> [--issue <n>] [--area <area>]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--since <value>` | From this date (YYYY-MM-DD) or time (ISO 8601) |
| `--issue <value>` | Only this issue and the change requests that close or reference it |
| `--area <value>` | Only issues, change requests and journal entries in this area |

## upstream

Draft an improvement for the public agent-os repository, filtered for privacy. Status: new (#71).

```
agent-os upstream draft (--title "<t>" --what "<text>" | --lesson <id>) [--proposal "<p>"] [--where "/skill|agent-os cmd"] [--key <config.key>…] [--kind feature|bug] [--file --approve [--new]]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--title <value>` | The improvement in one line |
| `--what <value>` | What happened or what is missing |
| `--proposal <value>` | What agent-os should do instead |
| `--where <value>` | The skill (/pr) or command (agent-os gate) involved |
| `--key <value>`, repeatable | A configuration key involved (names only, never values) |
| `--kind <value>` | feature (default) or bug |
| `--lesson <value>` | Draft from a lesson card (its text, filtered) |
| `--file` | Send it upstream (needs --approve) |
| `--approve` | The person has read the exact text and agrees |
| `--new` | File it even though a similar upstream issue exists |

## stack

Show and check the stack map against the catalog; write one from a blueprint. Status: new (#74).

```
agent-os stack show | check | catalog [check] | new --from <blueprint> [--project <name>] [--force] [--dry-run] | set <layer> <tech> [--why <text>] | status <layer> <status> [--why <text>] | detect [--write] | drift | import <file.csv|file.xlsx> [--sheet <name>] [--write [--force]] [--overlay] | propose --level <1-5> [--family typescript|polyglot] | compare <tech> <tech>   (render: later)
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--from <value>` | new: the blueprint id (catalog/blueprints.yaml) |
| `--project <value>` | new: the project name |
| `--force` | new: replace an existing stack.yaml |
| `--why <value>` | set, status: why, for the decision record |
| `--write` | detect, import: write stack.yaml (only when there is none, or with --force for import) |
| `--sheet <value>` | import: the sheet to read (default: the first with Layer and Technology columns) |
| `--level <value>` | propose: the product complexity level, 1 (simple) to 5 (complex) |
| `--family <value>` | propose: typescript (one language end to end) or polyglot |
| `--overlay` | import: add the technologies and layers the catalog lacks to .agent-os/catalog/ |

## system

Map components, interfaces, exposure and contracts (system.yaml): detect, check, show. Status: new (#113).

```
agent-os system detect [--write] | check | show | contracts [--base <branch>] | endpoints [--undocumented] | checks | spec <component> [--write <file>]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--write` | detect: write system.yaml (only when there is none) |
| `--base <value>` | contracts: the branch to compare with (default branches.integration) |
| `--write-to <value>` | spec: where to write the drafted OpenAPI file (default: print it) |
| `--undocumented` | endpoints: only the routes no spec documents, and spec operations no code declares |

## artifact

Create, list, check, build, verify and trace artifacts (link: later). Status: new (#82).

```
agent-os artifact new <discovery|analysis|stack-map|comparison|decision-support|release-report|retro|architecture|dashboard|audit|threat-model> <slug> [--title <t>] [--kind snapshot|living] [--author <login>…] [--ref <#N>…] [--from-journal [--since <date>] [--until <date>]] [--dry-run]
       agent-os artifact list [--type <type>]   ·   check   ·   log <id>
       agent-os artifact build <id> | --living [--dry-run]   ·   verify [<id>] [--strict]   ·   site [<out>] [--strict]
       agent-os artifact link <id> <#N | !N> [--dry-run]   (a comment with the repository link first, in the thread language)
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--title <value>` | new: the title (default: from the slug) |
| `--kind <value>` | new: snapshot or living (default: living for stack-map and dashboard, else snapshot) |
| `--author <value>`, repeatable | new: an author login (default: your platform login) |
| `--ref <value>`, repeatable | new: an issue, PR or decision it belongs to |
| `--type <value>` | list: only this type |
| `--from-journal` | new release-report: fill it from the journal entries (with --since and --until) |
| `--since <value>` | new --from-journal: entries from this date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `--until <value>` | new --from-journal: entries up to this date |
| `--living` | build: every living artifact made from a template (what CI rebuilds) |
| `--strict` | verify, site: exit 1 when an artifact is stale |

## pack

List, show, add and remove packs: optional rules, subagents, gate suites and requirements for a stack. Status: new (#55).

```
agent-os pack list | show <id> | add <id> [--dry-run] | remove <id> [--dry-run]   (agent-os add <id> is the same as pack add)
```

## add

Add a pack (the short form of agent-os pack add). Status: new (#55).

```
agent-os add <pack> [--dry-run]
```

## skills

The skill index: core, external and local skills, with what each does. Status: new (#41).

```
agent-os skills [--json]
```

## skill

Vendor, update, remove, scaffold and register skills; check the registry. Status: new (#39).

```
agent-os skill add <github:owner/repo[/path]@ref | ./folder> [--name <n>] [--license <id>] [--provides <slot>…] [--dry-run]
       agent-os skill update <name> [--ref <commit, tag or branch>] [--from <folder>] [--yes]
       agent-os skill remove <name> [--dry-run]   ·   new <name> [--description <d>]
       agent-os skill register <name> --origin local|external|plugin|builtin [--source <host:owner/repo@ref>] [--version <v>] [--license <id>] [--provides <slot>…] [--force] [--dry-run]   ·   check
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--origin <value>` | register: external, local, plugin, builtin |
| `--source <value>` | register: where it comes from; external skills pin a commit or tag (github:owner/repo@sha) |
| `--version <value>` | register: the skill version |
| `--license <value>` | register, add: its license id (MIT, Apache-2.0, …); add detects it from a LICENSE file |
| `--provides <value>`, repeatable | register, add: a capability slot it fills (repeat), e.g. review |
| `--force` | register: replace an existing entry |
| `--name <value>` | add: the skill name, when its SKILL.md has none |
| `--ref <value>` | update: the commit, tag or branch to move to (default: the ref it was added from) |
| `--from <value>` | update: the folder of a skill vendored from a local folder |
| `--yes` | update: replace the files without asking |
| `--description <value>` | new: the skill description |

## retrofit

Plan and apply history into the system for an existing repository. Status: new (#50).

```
agent-os retrofit plan [--dry-run]   ·   apply [--delay <ms>] [--dry-run]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--delay <value>` | apply: milliseconds between two writes to the platform (default 250) |

## ingest

Turn specifications into epics and sub-issues that cite their sections; contradictions are resolved first. Status: new (#53).

```
agent-os ingest plan [<file|folder>…]   ·   apply [--resolve <c1>=a|b|both…] [--milestone <m>] [--dry-run]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--resolve <value>`, repeatable | apply: how the person resolved a contradiction: <id>=a (keep the first), b (keep the second) or both (no conflict) |
| `--milestone <value>` | apply: the milestone for the created issues |

## discover

Infer the conventions an active repository follows, each with its evidence; apply only the accepted ones. Status: new (#52).

```
agent-os discover plan [--commits <n>]   ·   apply --accept <id>… [--dry-run]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--commits <value>` | plan: how many recent commits to read (default 500) |
| `--accept <value>`, repeatable | apply: a proposal id the person accepted (repeat) |

## audit

Plan an audit (subject, lenses, a brief per lens) and merge the lenses' findings. Status: new (#105).

```
agent-os audit plan "<what>" [--as <subject>] [--lens <add>…] [--no-lens <remove>…]   ·   merge <answer.json>…
agent-os audit report --plan <plan.json> <answer.json>… [--title <t>] [--dry-run]   (the artifact, compared with the previous audit)
agent-os audit propose <artifact-id> [--accept <n>…]   ·   verify <artifact-id>
agent-os audit upkeep [--report <sarif|gitleaks.json>…]   (maintenance: dependencies, secrets, licenses; proposals only)
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--as <value>` | plan: the subject, when the detected one is wrong (idea, spec, project, release, problem, system) |
| `--lens <value>`, repeatable | plan: add a lens (product, architecture, stack, code-quality, security-privacy, performance-cost, delivery, process, operations) |
| `--no-lens <value>`, repeatable | plan: remove a lens |
| `--plan <value>` | report: the saved output of audit plan --json |
| `--title <value>` | report: the artifact title |
| `--accept <value>`, repeatable | propose: a finding number the person accepted (repeat) |
| `--report <value>`, repeatable | upkeep: a scanner report to read (SARIF, gitleaks JSON); adds to security.reports |

```
agent-os runbook [--force] [--dry-run]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--force` | Replace runbooks that already exist |

Generate a software bill of materials (CycloneDX) from the lockfiles. Status: new (#108).

```
agent-os sbom [--out <file>] [--json]
```

## security

Watch the advisories that touch the dependencies (OSV, GHSA, KEV); keep the Security digest. Status: new (#108).

```
agent-os security watch [--issue] [--dry-run]   ·   pass [--base <branch>] [--report <sarif|gitleaks.json>…]   ·   threat-model [--force] [--dry-run]   ·   exercise [<name>]
```

| Option | What |
|---|---|
| `--issue` | watch: create or update the one Security digest issue |
| `--base <value>` | pass: the branch to compare with (default branches.integration) |
| `--report <value>`, repeatable | pass: a scanner report to read (SARIF, gitleaks JSON); adds to security.reports |
| `--force` | threat-model: regenerate even when it is current |
